name: MA Reverse
summary: This EA implements a mean reversion strategy based on moving average deviation. It enters trades when price reverses from an extreme deviation away from a moving average, expecting price to revert back toward the MA. Trades are opened in the direction of the expected reversion with configurable lot sizing and stop loss.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于均线偏离的均值回归策略。当价格从均线极端偏离后出现反转信号时入场，预期价格将回归均线方向。采用可配置的手数和止损进行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是均值回归，即当价格偏离移动均线过远时，预期价格将回归均线。入场条件为价格相对于均线的偏离达到一定阈值后出现反转信号，例如K线形态确认或动量指标转向。出场条件包括价格回归至均线附近止盈，或触及固定止损。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，部分版本可能支持基于账户余额的比例仓位。资金管理方面，止损设置是必要的，但缺少动态调整机制。整体策略逻辑简洁明了，但在强趋势行情中可能频繁逆势交易导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is mean reversion, expecting price to return to the moving average after significant deviation. Entry conditions trigger when price deviates from the MA beyond a threshold and shows reversal confirmation, such as candlestick patterns or momentum shifts. Exit conditions include take-profit when price reverts to the MA zone, or a fixed stop-loss level. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes, with some versions potentially supporting balance-based proportional sizing. Money management relies on stop-loss settings but lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is straightforward but may suffer consecutive losses in strong trending markets due to counter-trend trading.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Initial stop loss distance, 0 for no initial SL

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit per order in pips

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number to identify EA positions, 0 for all positions

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，易于理解和调试
均值回归在震荡行情中表现良好，具有统计优势
参数可配置性强，适合不同品种和时间周期优化
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and debug
Mean reversion performs well in ranging markets with statistical edge
Highly configurable parameters suitable for optimization across instruments and timeframes
cons: 在强趋势行情中逆势交易容易造成连续亏损
缺乏趋势过滤器，无法区分震荡与趋势市场
固定手数和止损缺乏动态资金管理机制
cons_en: Counter-trend trading in strong trending markets leads to consecutive losses
Lacks trend filter to distinguish between ranging and trending market conditions
Fixed lot size and stop-loss lack dynamic money management mechanisms
improvements: 添加趋势过滤器(如ADX或大周期MA方向)，避免在强趋势中逆势入场
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈，适应市场波动率变化
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher timeframe MA direction) to avoid counter-trend entries in strong trends
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt to changing market volatility

risk_points: 逆势交易在强趋势行情中可能导致连续止损
缺乏趋势识别和波动率过滤机制
固定止损可能无法适应不同市场波动环境
risk_points_en: Counter-trend trading can cause consecutive stop-losses in strong trending markets
Lacks trend identification and volatility filtering mechanisms
Fixed stop-loss may not adapt to varying market volatility environments
